purpose: Read-only expected-byte sample for a future UFS transport probe
capture_environment: TWRP through ADB; no XNU driver involved
read_command: adb exec-out dd if=/dev/block/sda bs=4096 skip=1 count=1 status=none
limits: This verifies the Linux/TWRP read and GPT header only; XNU UFS transport, queue ownership, SMMU and DMA remain untested.
The sample changes if the GPT header changes.
The device serial and raw block contents are not recorded.
